findings.requirement: No raw passwords stored — always hashed
findings.summary: user.model.js has no pre('save') bcrypt hook for passwordHash. The auth service and controller are confirmed stubs with no password-hashing logic, so there is currently no reachable code path that prevents a plain-text password from being persisted in MongoDB.
findings.consequence: Any User document saved with a plain-text string in passwordHash will store it raw in the database.
findings.correction: Add a pre('save') hook to user.model.js that bcrypt-hashes passwordHash when it is modified, mirroring the pattern already used in otp.model.js lines 14-18.
findings.resolution: pre('save') bcrypt hook already present in user.model.js (hashes passwordHash with saltRounds 12 when modified). Finding resolved.
